scenarios.name: ring_lookup_batch1k
scenarios.description: Consistent-hash key lookup (ring.GetNode). Per-op latency derived from 1000-op batches: single ops are ~140ns, below timer granularity, so the distribution is over batch means.

scenarios.name: store_get_sstable
scenarios.description: Point read served from an SSTable: bloom filter, index binary search, one block read (no block cache).

scenarios.name: store_get_sstable_cached
scenarios.description: Point read served from an SSTable through the shared block cache; steady state, so blocks arrive decompressed from memory with no disk read.

scenarios.name: durable_put_sequential
scenarios.description: WAL-durable write from a single writer: each write pays a full fsync (no group-commit batching).

scenarios.name: durable_put_concurrent8
scenarios.description: WAL-durable writes from 8 concurrent writers sharing fsyncs via group commit. Per-op latency includes time waiting on the shared fsync; throughput reflects the batching win.

scenarios.name: sync_state_serve
scenarios.description: Anti-entropy GET /sync served from the incrementally maintained Merkle tree over a 10k-key store.

scenarios.name: http_put_one
scenarios.description: HTTP PUT /keys/{key}?consistency=one through a 3-node in-process cluster (RF=3): coordinator write, replica fan-out, quorum wait.

scenarios.name: http_get_one
scenarios.description: HTTP GET /keys/{key}?consistency=one through a 3-node in-process cluster (RF=3): replica fan-out, R-quorum wait, sibling merge.

scenarios.name: http_put_quorum
scenarios.description: HTTP PUT /keys/{key}?consistency=quorum through a 3-node in-process cluster (RF=3): coordinator write, replica fan-out, quorum wait.

scenarios.name: http_get_quorum
scenarios.description: HTTP GET /keys/{key}?consistency=quorum through a 3-node in-process cluster (RF=3): replica fan-out, R-quorum wait, sibling merge.

scenarios.name: http_put_all
scenarios.description: HTTP PUT /keys/{key}?consistency=all through a 3-node in-process cluster (RF=3): coordinator write, replica fan-out, quorum wait.

scenarios.name: http_get_all
scenarios.description: HTTP GET /keys/{key}?consistency=all through a 3-node in-process cluster (RF=3): replica fan-out, R-quorum wait, sibling merge.

scenarios.name: http_scan_page100
scenarios.description: HTTP GET /keys?prefix= scan page (100 keys of a 5k-key prefix): scatter to all 3 nodes, dominance merge, horizon pagination.
